latestVersion.changelog:
Picture Slideshow Maker 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Instantly turns your uploaded photos into a slideshow video with background music and smooth transitions.
- Supports JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC images up to 200MB each; exports MP4, MOV, AVI, WEBM, MKV, JPG, PNG, GIF, WEBP, MP3, WAV, M4A, AAC.
- Automatic cloud processing: setup connects to backend and manages authentication, sessions, and uploads for you.
- Simple instructions: just describe your slideshow, upload images, and get a downloadable video in 30–90 seconds.
- Handles common workflows like quick edits, batch processing, and iterative refinement with real-time session management.
- Built-in error handling and user prompts for connecting accounts, checking credits, and troubleshooting file issues.
